Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. is a China-based chemical enterprise serving domestic and international customers with a focus on stable supply, consistent quality, and practical technical support. Located in Nanning, the capital city of Guangxi, the company benefits from the region’s connectivity to major industrial hubs in South China and to nearby ASEAN markets, enabling efficient coordination of sourcing, production, and logistics.  

The company’s business is centered on the manufacturing and distribution of industrial chemicals and chemical intermediates used across a wide range of applications, including water treatment, detergents and cleaning products, coatings and construction materials, mining and metallurgy, agriculture-related processing, and general industrial manufacturing. By working with upstream producers and downstream users, Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. aims to provide fit-for-purpose product options—covering common bulk chemicals as well as selected specialty items—along with packaging and delivery solutions aligned to customer requirements.  

In day-to-day operations, the company emphasizes reliable batch control, clear product documentation, and responsive service from inquiry through shipment. With a customer-oriented approach, Nanning Chemical Industry Co., Ltd. seeks long-term partnerships built on transparency, timely communication, and dependable performance in complex supply chains.
